units.source_text: 岛村不喜欢女人家这样厉害。

en.t: Shimamura did not like such sharpness in a woman.

units.source_text: 但是使她这么厉害的，倒不是岛村或是驹子本人有什么道理，

en.t: But what made her so sharp was not any particular reason in Shimamura or in Komako herself,

units.source_text: 这也许可以看作是驹子性格的一种表现吧。

en.t: perhaps it could be seen as one expression of Komako's character.

units.source_text: 总之，在她这样反复追问之下，他好像觉得敲击中要害似的。

en.t: At any rate, as she questioned him again and again like this, he seemed to feel as though she had struck a vital spot.

units.source_text: 今晨看见映着山上积雪的镜中的驹子时，

en.t: This morning, when he saw Komako in the mirror that reflected the snow on the mountains,

units.source_text: 岛村自然想起映在暮霭中的火车玻璃窗上的姑娘，

en.t: Shimamura naturally remembered the girl reflected in the train window in the evening mist,

units.source_text: 但他为什么没把这件事告诉驹子呢？

en.t: but why had he not told Komako about it?
